game.name: sugarscape
game.description: Grow a target social distribution by submitting one declarative SugarLang ruleset.

player.value:
https://github.com/Metta-AI/coworld-sugarscape/blob/main/docs/PROTOCOL.md

Research variants use sugarscape-research/1. Receive an observation with study, mode and parameter_schema; send {"type":"action","parameters":{...}}. Fixed reference modes require an empty object. Calibration uses the closed observed schema. Seeds and auth tokens are withheld from player observations. Study sources and scientific qualifications are recorded in replay/details. A missing submission fails the episode; no reference completion is manufactured.

player.name: Target-aware baseline
player.description: A readable canned SugarLang policy selected from the assigned target.

variants.name: Solo Wealth
variants.description: A single social scientist grows a globally skewed wealth distribution.

variants.description: One scientist, one drawn world: 80 scenarios (12 base worlds crossed with mechanic packs) spanning all seven targets.
